purpose: Daily skincare image research; visible appearance only; no disease diagnosis.

forbidden_tuning_groups.rule: Never use either historical locked test cohort for model selection, threshold tuning, prompt tuning, or error-driven augmentation.

lesion_detection.labels: expert or source-author boxes/masks; ACNE04 boxes are not masks
candidate_models: instance segmentation only when true masks exist

colour.design: same subject/region/device, fixed distance, fixed angle, reference colour target, no beauty filter
colour.claim_limit: Relative colour only until a physical reference target and ground-truth measurements are present.

multiview.claim_limit: Cross-view repetition alone does not prove height; stereo or photometric calibration is required.

qwen_integration.role: Explain structured evidence and uncertainty, not replace numeric modules

controlled_variables.synthetic_probe_limit: Synthetic variants test sensitivity only and cannot validate real colour or surface-height accuracy.

research_gates.subgroup_reporting: Report device and skin-tone strata; do not claim a subgroup result with n<20.
research_gates.clinical_gate: None. Clinical validation requires a separate prospective protocol and expert ground truth.
